content_sections.heading: CGPSC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 3 for Microbiologist (Food Laboratory) and 2 for Microbiologist (Drug Laboratory).

content_sections.heading: CGPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Microbiologist (Food Laboratory): M.Sc. Microbiology with 5 years experience in food testing laboratory, or qualification as per Food Safety and Standards Rules 2011. Microbiologist (Drug Laboratory): M.Sc. Microbiology with 5 years experience in drug testing laboratory, or qualification as per Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945.

content_sections.heading: CGPSC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 25 years Maximum Age: 35 years Age Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC: 5 years; Women: 10 years; Ex-Servicemen: as per rules; PWD: 5 years; others as per Chhattisgarh Govt rules; max age 45 years with all relaxations. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CGPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CGPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CGPSC Microbiologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CGPSC Microbiologist posts is 09-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Microbiologist posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 25 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years for the Microbiologist positions. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Microbiologist role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Microbiology with 5 years of experience, along with specific qualifications like Food Analyst or Government Analyst as per relevant rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Microbiologist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Microbiologist post, divided into two specializations: Food Laboratory and Drug Laboratory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is 400. For SC/ST and Women candidates, the fee is 300.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Microbiologist position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 56100 to Rs. 177500 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CGPSC Microbiologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. When does the online application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process for the CGPSC Microbiologist recruitment starts on 10-09-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or from the official CGPSC website.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any provision for error correction in the application form?
faq.answer: Yes, there are provisions for both free error correction (10-10-2026 to 12-10-2026) and paid error correction (13-10-2026 to 15-10-2026).
